fusions.name: Skip-Bite
fusions.desc: You leap up to 7 tiles to the target and bite it for 14 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 6 seconds and [Diseased] for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Fever Sip
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: sends a sting that deals 8 blood damage, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Far Side
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a point up to 6 tiles away. Your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Carrier's Appetite
fusions.desc: Each time you afflict something, you heal for 20% of the damage you deal for 5 seconds. Once every 8 seconds.
